suites.title: TC-01: Login with a valid and an invalid password

specs.title: TC-01 login fails with a wrong password and works with the correct one

steps.title: 1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. Open the account menu: nobody is logged in
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu: the customer is logged in

suites.title: TC-02: Add a product to the basket

specs.title: TC-02 product added from the product list shows in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Add the product to the basket
3. Open the basket
4. Read the total of the basket

suites.title: TC-03: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

specs.title: TC-03 plus, minus and trash buttons update the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Click plus on product A
3. Click minus on product A
4. Click minus on product A again: the quantity stays 1
5. Click trash on product A

suites.title: TC-04: Purchase limit for one product

specs.title: TC-04 basket holds at most the limit of a limited product

steps.title: 1. Add the product from the product list
2. Click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click plus one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Add the product again from the product list

specs.title: TC-08 wallet pays only when it holds the order total

steps.title: 1. Checkout and select the saved address
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue
3. The button Pay 8.99¤ is disabled
4. The order history is empty
5. The wallet balance is unchanged
Top up the wallet with 3.99 from the saved card
6. Checkout to the payment step again
7. Click Pay 8.99¤
8. Place the order
9. The wallet balance is the rest plus the bonus
10. The order history shows the order
